messages.content: What's the recipe to cook five chicken

function.name: recipe_calculator_calculate_time
function.description: Calculates the time to cook a recipe based on weight and per unit time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight.description: The weight of the item to be cooked. This is a float type value.

per_unit_time.description: The time required to cook per unit weight.

unit_of_time.description: Unit of time, such as minutes or hours. Default is minutes.

message.reasoning: The user asks: "What's the recipe to cook five chicken". They want a recipe to cook five chickens. We need to provide a recipe. The user didn't specify cooking method. We can give a general recipe for roasted chicken. Provide ingredients, steps, cooking time. Also mention cooking time calculation. We can use the function to calculate cooking time: weight of each chicken? Let's assume average weight 1.5 kg per chicken. So total weight 7.5 kg. Per unit time maybe 20 minutes per kg? But we can just give a standard roasting time: 20 minutes per pound plus 10 minutes. Or we can use the function to calculate time: weight=7.5, per_unit_time=20 minutes per kg? Actually typical roasting time: 20 minutes per pound (0.45 kg). So per unit time = 20 minutes per 0.45 kg => about 44.44 minutes per kg. But we can just give approximate. Use function: weight=7.5, per_unit_time=44.44, unit_of_time="minutes". That will return time. Let's call function.
